title: How to ask a question in seminar
courseLabel: Sample first-year seminar (not an official course)

blocks.text: A useful seminar question points at a specific spot in the text or the lecture, then says what you don't yet understand.
Try: location, confusion, stake. Where in the idea, what is unclear, and why the answer would change your reading.
When you have the Ask a question ability, pick a prompt. The reply is written on this lesson. It is not a live professor.

prompts.question: Is this reading important?
prompts.instructorResponse: That is too broad to answer well. Name the paragraph that bothered you and what you expected it to say.

prompts.question: In the second claim, is the example doing the work of the definition, or just illustrating it?
prompts.instructorResponse: That is a seminar question. You located a claim and asked what job the example has. Write it in your notebook before you forget the wording.
